ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) bifurcated region at the peduncle junction; continuous low-intensity perimeter band along the trailing edge; two large high-intensity (white) contiguous fields occupying the primary surface area of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge; notably sharper peaks present on the distal sections of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-up sweep along the trailing edge leading to tapered, high-contrast distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark pixel clusters located on the distal tip of the right lobe and scattered near the transition zone of the central black patch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, nearly vertical high-contrast dark linear streaks on the left lobe; two diagonal linear marks on the right lobe, appearing as rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes and significant irregular serration/notching along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark 'V' or 'M' shaped pigmentation pattern at the base where the fluke meets the peduncle.
